title: Naturally Smoky Irish Beef Flank Steak Grill
description: A pungent and aerated Irish dish featuring beef flank steak, perfect for a date night, cooked on a yakimono-grill with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked sea salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Rub the spice mixture all over the beef flank steak, making sure to coat it evenly.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Place the beef flank steak on the grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once cooked, let the steak rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and drizzle with lemon juice.
